user.title: Import Hydro One Green Button XML
user.description: Enter the absolute path to a Green Button XML file or a folder containing XML exports, accessible to Home Assistant. Example: {example_path}. For automatic weekly imports, use a dedicated folder and drop each new .xml export into it.

error.file_not_found: The path was not found. Check the path and make sure it exists on the Home Assistant system.
error.permission_denied: Home Assistant does not have permission to read this path.
error.invalid_file: No supported Green Button XML usage data could be read from this file or folder.

init.title: Change Hydro One XML source
init.description: Enter a single XML file path or a dedicated folder containing XML exports. Use a folder for automatic incremental weekly imports. Example: {example_path}.

error.file_not_found: The path was not found. Check the path and make sure it exists on the Home Assistant system.
error.permission_denied: Home Assistant does not have permission to read this path.
